name: Rad Balek 1.2.1 — more reliable, more honest
body:
**Siren & alerts (reliability)**
- The siren always returns to full volume after the spoken announcement (never stays muted)
- The announcement no longer goes silent in both languages — if the French voice is missing it falls through to Arabic
- A red alert shows even if it arrives right after an app update, before the app is first opened
- A second red while one is already showing is handled correctly

**Honest data**
- No more fabricated green "low risk" when weather is unavailable — the tile hides instead of inventing an all-clear
- No more "null°C" leaks when a field is missing
- An expired red (in an offline cache) no longer drives the full-screen takeover — shown with its dated validity instead
- Resilient to malformed data: one bad alert no longer blanks all the others

**Privacy & permissions**
- Coarse (approximate) location only
- Emergency call opens the dialer with the number pre-filled

Not an official government service. In an emergency, call Protection Civile: 14 or 1021.

APK: app-release.apk (universal, all devices).
